locations.note: The Commonwealth: a post-nuclear Boston where the Sole Survivor hunts for their kidnapped son.
Diamond City, the Commonwealth's biggest settlement, is built on the diamond inside Fenway Park's walls.
The Institute, the synth-makers hidden underground, grew out of the ruins of MIT, called the Commonwealth Institute of Technology in the game.
The ruins of Cambridge across the river, with the Institute beneath them.
The Freedom Trail ends at the Old North Church, where the Railroad has its headquarters in the crypt.
The caravan settlement of Bunker Hill clusters around the monument, and the factions fight over a synth there.
Old Ironsides sits wedged in a bank building, her robot crew still trying to sail her: The Last Voyage of the USS Constitution.
The gold dome of the State House stands over the ruins, its halls held by mirelurks.
The Common with Swan's Pond, where a super mutant behemoth waits for anyone who comes too close.
The Public Library, overrun by super mutants, its book-return machines still paying out.
Faneuil Hall, a super mutant stronghold on the old market square.
Trinity Church, a ghoul-haunted ruin on Copley Square.
Goodneighbor, Hancock's town of drifters and ghouls, is built on Scollay Square.
The Castle: Fort Independence, the Minutemen's old headquarters, retaken from the mirelurks in Taking Independence.
The Brotherhood of Steel makes its base at the ruined airport, with the airship Prydwen moored above it.
